question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'NON-VEG' THEN 'Non-Veg'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS food_group,
    i.ORDER_ITEM_ID,
    i.QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER_ITEM AS i
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER AS o
    ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_FOOD AS f
    ON i.FOOD_ID = f.FOOD_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
),
group_totals AS (
  SELECT food_group, COUNT(ORDER_ITEM_ID) AS item_line_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(QUANTITY), 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY food_group
),
groups AS (
  SELECT column1 AS food_group
  FROM VALUES ('Veg'), ('Non-Veg'), ('Unknown')
),
complete_totals AS (
  SELECT g.food_group,
         COALESCE(t.item_line_count, 0) AS item_line_count,
         COALESCE(t.ordered_units, 0) AS ordered_units
  FROM groups AS g
  LEFT JOIN group_totals AS t ON g.food_group = t.food_group
),
denominator AS (
  SELECT SUM(ordered_units) AS total_ordered_units FROM complete_totals
)
SELECT c.food_group, c.item_line_count, c.ordered_units,
       100.0 * c.ordered_units / NULLIF(d.total_ordered_units, 0) AS share_of_total_ordered_units_pct,
       d.total_ordered_units
FROM complete_totals AS c
CROSS JOIN denominator AS d
ORDER BY CASE c.food_group WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

action.answer:
For item lines belonging to orders with recorded ORDER_DATE from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, classified by the joined food dimension (null or unmatched food IDs are Unknown):

| Group | Item-line count | Ordered units | Share of ordered units |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Veg | 7,277,939 | 8,877,759 units | 72.584811% |
| Non-Veg | 2,749,222 | 3,353,105 units | 27.415082% |
| Unknown | 12 | 13 units | 0.000106% |

The denominator is **12,230,877 total ordered units** across all three groups. Shares are each group's ordered units divided by that denominator, multiplied by 100.
